note: Starting values, chosen before there is real data. Tune them against what the daily reports actually show. A rule never fires below its minimums: min_installs is distinct installs and min_events is the size of the thing the rate is measured over (attempts for gesture rates and refusal shares, install-days for launches and stops per active hour). Per-hour rules also need min_active_hours.

rules.description: Talk (pinch) succeeds less than 60% of the time
rules.investigation: Replay the pinch fixtures against the camera formats and lighting seen in the report, then check pinch timing in docs/gotchas.md.

rules.description: Send (thumbs up) succeeds less than 60% of the time
rules.investigation: Compare thumbs-up attempts with the sends_refused reasons below; a high refusal share usually means the send rules, not the pose, are failing.

rules.description: Scroll succeeds less than 60% of the time
rules.investigation: Check how Claude's scroll area is found (docs/gotchas.md, scrolling) on the macOS versions in the report.

rules.description: Peace sign succeeds less than 50% of the time
rules.investigation: Replay the peace-sign fixtures and check that the action it triggers is reachable in current Claude builds.

rules.description: Scissors succeeds less than 50% of the time
rules.investigation: Replay the scissors fixtures and check that the action it triggers is reachable in current Claude builds.

rules.description: Talk (pinch) got worse in a newer version
rules.investigation: Diff the gesture and camera changes between the two versions named in the report.

rules.description: Send (thumbs up) got worse in a newer version
rules.investigation: Diff the send and gesture changes between the two versions named in the report.

rules.description: Ensemble starts more than 5 times per install-day
rules.investigation: Suspect a crash loop or a login-item restart cycle in the versions named; check the launch path and recent changes to startup.

rules.description: Dead-man safety stops are frequent
rules.investigation: Check the dead-man interval against how long people dictate (docs/safety.md).

rules.description: Standing-check safety stops are frequent
rules.investigation: Check the standing-check conditions for false positives (docs/safety.md).

rules.description: Multiple-faces safety stops are frequent
rules.investigation: Check the face detector for ghost second faces (posters, reflections) in the camera formats seen.

rules.description: No-face safety stops are frequent
rules.investigation: Check face-loss tolerance and the lighting or camera formats where it happens.

rules.description: Camera-covered safety stops are frequent
rules.investigation: Check the dark-frame test against dim rooms and low-light camera formats.

rules.description: Other-microphone safety stops are frequent
rules.investigation: Check how another app's microphone use is detected and whether Ensemble's own capture is miscounted.

rules.description: Typing-or-click safety stops are frequent
rules.investigation: Check whether Ensemble's own synthetic input is being read as the user's typing or clicking.

rules.description: Input-device-changed safety stops are frequent
rules.investigation: Check for audio route flapping (Bluetooth headphones) triggering the stop.

rules.description: Sleep-or-lock safety stops are frequent
rules.investigation: Check that the camera stops with the screen and that a stop is not repeated on wake.

rules.description: Claude-quit safety stops are frequent
rules.investigation: Check whether Claude desktop is crashing or restarting during dictation.

rules.description: More than 25% of Send attempts are refused because Claude is not ready
rules.investigation: Claude's labels or layout probably changed; check the send-button and composer lookups (docs/gotchas.md).

rules.description: More than 10% of Send attempts are refused because the stop was not confirmed
rules.investigation: Check how the end of dictation is confirmed against Claude's microphone control.

rules.description: More than 20% of Send attempts are refused for an unclassified reason
rules.investigation: A refusal notice was reworded or added without a rule in SendRefusal.classify; find the new wording.
